title: 历史降雨驱动 · 地表积水试算

grid.order: north to south rows; west to east columns

assumptions.case: measured rg5425 rain on assumed initial river stage and boundary; not validated historical inundation
assumptions.boundary: west river crossing inlet stage / east river corridor outlet stage; remaining boundaries reflective
assumptions.rainfall: rg5425 measured minute volumes, spatially uniform; source timestamp interpreted as interval start
assumptions.hydraulic_terrain: native 0.4 m -> 4 m averages -> 16 m cross mesh
assumptions.building_obstacles: finite raised beds using schematic eaves+roof heights; openings and sub-grid lanes unresolved
assumptions.drainage: none; upper-bound sensitivity, not coupled to SWMM
assumptions.rendering: local convex wet-neighbour stage interpolation on 8 m grid; hidden building interiors filled from adjacent wet cells; native stats are authoritative
assumptions.particles: instantaneous velocity-field tracers, not debris or real tracked objects
assumptions.boundary_momentum: zero prescribed momentum at both reservoir-stage boundaries
assumptions.rain_time_convention: each minute value applies to [timestamp,timestamp+60s); dry gaps in event file treated as zero
